data.body: **[P2] Do not recognize malformed envelopes by substring search.** A supported non-JSON delegate can legitimately receive raw initial input or callback/invoke data containing `__durable_execution_filesystem_serdes`; if parsing fails, this branch rejects that payload before the delegate sees it. First determine that the payload is a JSON object containing the marker—then apply strict duplicate/trailing-token validation—and otherwise delegate unchanged. Add a raw custom-delegate regression test containing the marker text.
